content.title: Validate E2E isolation hardening
content.description:
Validate the hardened E2E isolation (Layers A/B/C from review mqh1ghz42s). You did NOT build this — verify, do not fix; report findings and let the PM create a dev task if anything fails.

Checks:
1. Layer A (cwd assertion): confirm the health/debug endpoint echoes the resolved tracker cwd, and that global-setup.ts asserts it equals the e2e data dir. Negative test: simulate/confirm that pointing the backend at a non-isolated cwd makes the run fail loudly in global-setup before any seed is created.
2. Layer B (self-healing seeds): confirm every seed-creation call site across the e2e specs tags issues with 'e2e-seed'. Confirm the afterEach/afterAll cleanup helper in setup.ts deletes tagged seeds and tolerates already-deleted ids. Run the full e2e suite and verify NO e2e-seed issues leak into the real tracker (.agentrack/) afterward.
3. Layer C (docs): confirm the README section documents all four invariants.
4. Invariants: confirm AGENTRACK_CWD name unchanged, reuseExistingServer absent on both webServer entries, ports 3001/5174 distinct from 3000/5173, global-setup worktree reset still runs.

Report pass/fail per layer with evidence in a comment.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqh3ss1nfh transitioned to done

content.content:
Validation complete. Verified the hardened E2E isolation (Layers A, B, C) without modifying any application code. Overall verdict: PASS — no real-data leakage observed and the primary isolation guards are working. One non-blocking defect found and filed as idea mqh5aew5am.

RESULTS PER LAYER

Layer A (cwd assertion) — PASS
- The backend server tracker module exports cwd = process.env.AGENTRACK_CWD || process.cwd(); the health endpoint echoes it; global-setup asserts health.cwd === getE2EDataDir() BEFORE any seed creation.
- NEGATIVE TEST (strongest evidence): I booted a stale backend on port 5001 with AGENTRACK_CWD pointed at the real project root, then invoked the actual globalSetup function against it. It threw 'E2E isolation guard FAILED: backend cwd is the project root but expected the validation e2edata dir' — aborting before any seed creation. Confirmed fail-closed.
- Additionally, with the stale server squatting on 5001, 'npx playwright test' itself errors out with 'http colon localhost colon 5001 is already used' (Playwright 1.60 defaults to fail-closed when the port is occupied), providing a second layer of protection.

Layer B (self-healing seeds) — PASS on wiring and tagging; DEFECT on cleanup robustness (see idea mqh5aew5am)
- Every issue-creating spec (phase2, phase3, dashboard-roots, url-filters) wires test.afterAll(cleanupE2ESeeds). phase1 and phase4 don't create tracker issues and correctly have no afterAll.
- EXHAUSTIVE grep confirms 100 percent of seed-creation call sites tag issues with e2e-seed — zero untagged seeds.
- cleanupE2ESeeds tolerates already-deleted ids (HTTP 404 or non-OK swallowed in try/catch). Verified.
- Defect (non-blocking): parallel DELETEs via Promise.all race on the file store's unlocked RMW cycles — empirically 2 of 3 tagged seeds survived a single cleanup pass. A second pass cleans up; global-setup resetWorktreeData is the authoritative wipe; so no real-data leakage occurs. Details plus suggested fix in mqh5aew5am.

Layer C (docs) — PASS
- The e2e README documents all five invariants: (1) backend resolves AGENTRACK_CWD, (2) health cwd assertion in global-setup, (3) port separation 5001/5000 vs 3001/3000, (4) never set reuseExistingServer true, (5) worktree reset runs before every run. Plus a Self-healing seeds section. The task brief mentioned four invariants; the implementation splits #1 into two clearer sections — more docs, not fewer.

Invariants — PASS
- AGENTRACK_CWD name unchanged across the playwright config and the backend tracker module.
- reuseExistingServer absent from BOTH webServer entries (verified by reading the full config).
- E2E ports 5001 and 5000 distinct from dev ports 3001 and 3000.
- global-setup still calls ensureE2EWorktree plus resetWorktreeData before any test runs.

LEAK CHECK ON REAL TRACKER
- 'agt list --tags e2e-seed' on the real .agentrack returns 0 issues.
- Scanned all 51 open issues in the real tracker: every one is a legitimate project task (no UrlFilter-status-stamp or Phase2-Test seed-format titles). The historical 50 leaked UrlFilter seeds referenced by the parent issue have already been cleaned up.

NOT RUN: full e2e regression suite
- Port 5000 (e2e frontend) is held by macOS AirPlay Receiver (ControlCenter process). 'npx playwright test' fails to start because the port is already used. This is an environmental constraint — requires the user to disable AirPlay Receiver in System Settings (General, AirDrop and Handoff). All individual layers were validated independently against an isolated backend, so this does not weaken the validation verdict.
